symptoms: Dark brown to black concentric target-board rings on older lower leaves
Yellow chlorotic halo surrounding brown lesions
Stem collar rot and premature leaf drop reducing fruit yield

organicRemedies.name: Sour Buttermilk (खट्टा छाछ) + Asafoetida (हींग) Spray
organicRemedies.nameHi: खट्टी छाछ और हींग का प्राकृतिक फफूंदनाशक घोल
organicRemedies.description: Mix 1 Litre 4-5 days old sour fermented buttermilk with 10 Litres water and 5g asafoetida. Spray thoroughly in early morning. The lactic acid bacteria suppress Alternaria fungal spores.

organicRemedies.name: 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Neem Oil
organicRemedies.nameHi: 5% नीम बीज अर्क या नीम तेल (3 मिली/लीटर)
organicRemedies.description: Mix 45ml Neem Oil with 15L water and 5ml liquid soap as emulsifier. Coats leaves with azadirachtin, preventing fungal spore germination.

organicRemedies.name: Trichoderma viride Bio-fungicide
organicRemedies.description: Dissolve 50-75g Trichoderma powder in 15L water with 50g jaggery. Spray foliage and drench root zone.

chemicalRemedies.name: Mancozeb 75% WP (Indofil M-45)
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Protective contact fungicide. Spray on both leaf surfaces. Do not spray during strong midday sun.

chemicalRemedies.name: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC (Amistar Top)
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Systemic curative fungicide for severe spreading blight. Provides 14-day persistent protection.

preventionTips: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; keep leaf canopy dry
Prune bottom 6 inches of foliage to prevent soil splash transmission
Rotate crop with non-solanaceous crops (maize, pulses) for 2 seasons

symptoms: Rosetted flower buds ('rosette' flowers failing to open normally)
Entry boreholes on bolls sealed with frass/larval excreta
Stained lint and premature boll dropping with hollowed seeds

organicRemedies.name: Pheromone Trap Lure (Gossyplure)
organicRemedies.description: Install 8-10 pheromone traps per acre at crop canopy height. Captures male moths, disrupting mating cycles.

organicRemedies.name: Trichogramma bactrae Parasitoid Cards (Tricho-Cards)
organicRemedies.description: Staple 2-3 Tricho-cards per acre on underside of cotton leaves. Beneficial mini-wasps parasitize and destroy bollworm eggs.
organicRemedies.frequency: Release every 10 days during flowering/boll stage

organicRemedies.name: Neem Oil 10,000 PPM
organicRemedies.description: Spray 35-40ml in 15L water. Repels egg-laying moths and inhibits larval feeding.

chemicalRemedies.name: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG (Proclaim)
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Effective on young caterpillars before they burrow deep inside bolls. Spray at evening.

chemicalRemedies.name: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (Coragen)
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Target when economic threshold exceeds 8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive nights.

preventionTips: Avoid extending cotton ratoon crop beyond 150 days to break pest lifecycle
Hang bird perches (15-20 per acre) so predatory birds eat caterpillars
Burn or deep plow crop residue after final picking

symptoms: Diamond/spindle-shaped lesions with grey or whitish centers and brown/red margins
Lesions enlarge and coalesce, burning and drying up entire leaf blades
Neck blast causing black rot at panicle base, leading to empty white chaffy grains

organicRemedies.name: Pseudomonas fluorescens Bio-Control
organicRemedies.description: Dissolve 100g Pseudomonas powder in 15L water. Produces antifungal metabolites that block blast spore growth.
organicRemedies.frequency: Early morning spray at boot-leaf stage

organicRemedies.name: Cow Urine (गोमूत्र) + Neem & Calotropis Leaf Extract
organicRemedies.nameHi: देसी गोमूत्र, नीम और मदार पत्ती का काढ़ा
organicRemedies.description: Boil 1L cow urine with crushed neem and aak (calotropis) leaves. Dilute in 15L water. Acts as strong biopesticide.

chemicalRemedies.name: Tricyclazole 75% WP (Beam / Baan)
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Gold-standard blast fungicide. Inhibits melanin biosynthesis in fungal appressoria. Spray at initial spot appearance.

chemicalRemedies.name: Isoprothiolane 40% EC (Fuji-One)
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Effective for both leaf blast and neck blast stages.

preventionTips: Avoid excessive split doses of Urea/Nitrogen fertilizers which make leaves succulent and prone to blast
Maintain 5cm standing water in paddy fields; avoid severe drought stress
Use certified blast-resistant varieties (MTU-1010, IR-64, Swarna Sub-1)

symptoms: Water-soaked irregular pale green/brown spots at leaf tips and margins
White cottony mildew or mold growth on underside of leaves in morning mist
Rapidly turns entire foliage black and foul-smelling within 48-72 hours under cool foggy weather

organicRemedies.name: Bordeaux Mixture (1%) Spray
organicRemedies.description: Dissolve 150g Copper Sulphate (नीला थोथा) and 150g Quick Lime in 15L water. Tested organic protector against late blight.

organicRemedies.name: Garlic-Chilli Herbal Extract Spray
organicRemedies.nameHi: लहसुन और तीखी मिर्च का अर्क
organicRemedies.description: Crush 100g garlic + 50g pungent chillies, soak in 2L water overnight, filter and mix with 13L water. Natural antimicrobial barrier.

chemicalRemedies.name: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil Gold)
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Dual systemic and contact action. Stops mycelium spread inside tubers and leaves.

chemicalRemedies.name: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Curzate)
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Curative 'kickback' action within 48 hours of infection onset.

preventionTips: Do not irrigate during cloudy or foggy weather
Earth up soil well around stems so spores washed from leaves do not reach underground tubers
Dehaulm (cut and remove top foliage) 10-12 days before tuber digging

diseaseName: Chilli Leaf Curl & Thrips Murda Complex
pathogen: Virus (ChLCV) vectored by Whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci) & Yellow Mites/Thrips
symptoms: Upward curling of leaf margins like a boat/cup due to thrips sucking sap
Downward curling of leaves like inverted cup caused by mite feeding
Puckering, thickening of leaves, severe stunting and flower abortion

organicRemedies.name: Yellow & Blue Sticky Sticky Traps
organicRemedies.description: Install 25 yellow sheets (for whiteflies/aphids) and 15 blue sheets (for thrips) per acre at 1 foot above crop.

organicRemedies.name: Dashaparni Kashayam (10-leaf herbal extract)
organicRemedies.nameHi: दशपर्णी काढ़ा (10 औषधीय पत्तियों का अर्क)
organicRemedies.description: Traditional fermented concoction of neem, custard apple, papaya, calotropis leaves in cow urine. Sprayed 300ml per 15L pump.

chemicalRemedies.name: Fipronil 5% SC (Regent)
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Controls thrips effectively. Spray underside of leaves.

chemicalRemedies.name: Diafenthiuron 50% WP (Pegasus)
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Broad spectrum against both mites and whitefly nymphs. Activates in presence of sunlight.

preventionTips: Grow 3-4 border rows of tall maize or jowar around chilli field as physical insect barrier
Remove and destroy virus-infected plants immediately to stop secondary spread
Spray 5% neem extract at nursery stage before transplanting

regionalNames.hi: पौधा पूर्णतः स्वस्थ है (कोई रोग नहीं)

symptoms: Vibrant green leaf lamina without necrotic lesions or yellow halos
Sturdy stem node spacing and active apical bud growth
No pest webbing, punctures, or honeydew secretions detected

organicRemedies.name: Jeevamrit (जीवामृत) Growth Booster & Soil Conditioner
organicRemedies.description: Apply 200L prepared Jeevamrit with irrigation water every 15 days to multiply beneficial soil mycorrhiza and earthworms.

organicRemedies.name: Panchagavya Foliar Tonic
organicRemedies.description: Spray 450ml in 15L water to enhance photosynthetic efficiency, flowering retention, and disease resistance.

chemicalRemedies.name: Water Soluble NPK 19:19:19 Foliar Grade
chemicalRemedies.instructions: Balanced micronutrient nutrition for maximum vegetative tillering and yield boost.

preventionTips: Maintain weed-free field borders to deny shelter to pest vectors
Conduct regular crop scouting twice weekly in morning hours
Test soil every 2 years to apply tailored organic compost
